Please do not attach API keys, passwords, tokens, complete private chats, databases,
account exports, or unredacted logs. Use a minimal synthetic example. Check screenshots
and paths for personal information before posting.
请勿上传密钥、密码、令牌、完整私聊、数据库、账号导出或未经脱敏的日志。
请使用最小合成示例，并检查截图与路径中的个人信息。

For suspected vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md instead of disclosing sensitive
reproduction details here. This public issue form is not a private security channel.
安全问题请先阅读 SECURITY.md；本表单是公开的，不是私密报告渠道。
